patch.value: pm health advises pm history-repair for history_drift_missing_stream, but history-repair refuses a stream with no entries

When an item's history stream is missing, pm health reports history_drift_missing_stream with the remedy pm history-repair <id>, rewritten to pm history-repair --all when several streams drift. history-repair cannot rebuild a missing stream: the --all row fails with 'No history entries exist for <id>; nothing to repair.' and the command exits 1. Found on PR #1762 while running the advised remedies on a mixed-drift fixture (one chain mismatch, one missing stream) in tests/integration/lifecycle/history-bridge.integration.spec.ts. The remedy registry entry lives in src/core/diagnostics/remediation.ts, and the bulk rewrite lives in rewriteBulkHealthRemediation in src/sdk/governance/health.ts. The fix names a command that actually rebuilds or records the missing stream, for example a baseline-reseed step, or a restore when an item can be rebuilt from history; it must also keep the bulk rewrite from advising --all for a code that --all cannot repair.
An integration spec runs the remedy pm health names for a missing stream, per item and in bulk, and the history_drift check is ok afterwards
Every remedy pm health names for history_drift_missing_stream, per item and in bulk, runs to a clean history_drift check
pm history-repair <id> and pm history-repair --all refuse the missing stream with 'No history entries exist; nothing to repair.' and exit 1

value.text: A second remedy-accuracy case, from CodeRabbit on PR #1762: the drift scanner reports history_drift_chain_mismatch both for a bridgeable break and for a patch that only applies on top of the unrecorded change. So when every drifted stream is a chain mismatch, pm health advises pm history-repair --all --append-only, which bridges the first kind and refuses the second with patch_does_not_replay; strict health stays unclean. The fix belongs with this item: the scanner, or the remedy selection, must tell a bridgeable chain mismatch from one that needs the rewriting repair, and the integration spec must run each advised remedy to a clean history_drift check.
